summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of The Alchemical Lexicon. All 11 pytest cases pass (lexicon shape 33/3/18, trials 5, all 4 named recipes success, monster + inert branches, progress upsert/get/persist). Full frontend loop verified via Playwright: intro overlay -> Enter Lab -> tile assembly (Autocrat, Econocrat, Bioluminescent) -> Spark Vignette modal (title, image, etymology) -> Continue closes. Constellation switching works (rule-order/light-vision/form-change tabs). Words charted counter increments and persists across page reload (localStorage session + backend). Philosopher's Tree renders discovered nodes only in their own constellation tab (default rule-order) — autocrat node visible and clicking reopens vignette. Trials tab renders options; correct answer for t-vents (o3 Technocrat) increments 'trials mastered' to 1/5. Bestiary shows discovered image+definition, undiscovered locks. Voice incantation button renders and click does not crash (Web Speech skipped in headless).

issues: Radix Dialog console warnings: DialogContent missing DialogTitle and aria-describedby. Accessibility warning only — modal still renders and works. Consider adding VisuallyHidden DialogTitle + DialogDescription for screen-reader compliance.

action_items: (Low priority) Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle / DialogDescription in SparkVignette.jsx to silence Radix a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: solid, uses env vars, excludes _id, proper async Mongo. No issues.

PhilosophersTree only shows nodes for the currently active constellation — intentional radial UX; discovered words in other constellations require tab switch. Not a bug but worth confirming with product.
App.js nav tab id for the Crucible view is 'workbench' -> data-testid=nav-tab-workbench (spec mentions nav-tab-tree/trials/bestiary only, so this is fine).
Tile order-sensitivity: recipes are ordered sequences; UI clicking appends in order which is correct.
test_credentials: N/A — no login. Session UUID stored in localStorage.
seed_data_creation: Test progress documents inserted under session_id prefix 'TEST_' — safe to leave, no cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Frontend Crucible tab uses data-testid='nav-tab-workbench' (not nav-tab-crucible). Philosopher's Tree only renders nodes for the active constellation tab (default rule-order); switch tab to see other discovered words. Web Speech / voice button testing is skipped in headless — only render/no-crash verified.
